newsitem.title: USA: Harnischfeger ends offer for Giddings.
newsitem.headline: Harnischfeger ends offer for Giddings.

text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said Monday its tender offer for Giddings & Lewis Inc expired on June 20 and will not be extended.

Harnischfeger said no shares were purchased and all tendered shares will be returned because conditions to the offer were not satisfied. Harnischfeger had previously launched a $19 a share hostile bid for Giddings.
Fond du Lac, Wisconsin-based Giddings's had initially rejected the $19 a share offer by mining, paper making and material handling equipment maker Harnischfeger as inadequate.

Harnischfeger proceeded with the tender offer, but its bid was trumped earlier this month by a deal between Giddings and German steel engineering giant Thyssen AG for Thyssen to pay $21 a share to acquire Giddings.

"As we stated earlier, we will not engage in a bidding war with Thyssen for (Giddings)," Harnischfeger chief executive Jeffery Grade said in a news release. "We are disciplined acquirors with many alternatives to develop our Industrial Products & Services strategy."
